Apple launches Watch Ultra 4 in India with better battery

Apple introduced the Watch Ultra 4 at its 2026 event, making it available in India. The device is priced at Rs 1,09,900 for the Indian market. Business Today reported that the Ultra 4 offers longer battery life, new interchangeable bands and smarter daily summary functions. Times Now noted that pre‑booking began following the launch and that the official sale date has not yet been announced. Punjab Kesari covered the live event, mentioning the launch of the Ultra 4 alongside the Apple Watch Series 12 and other products such as the iPhone Ultra. The coverage did not indicate any regulatory or supply issues, and the launch proceeds as scheduled.
